hero.subtitle: Discover a modern learning environment designed to propel your professional ambitions in Madagascar.

about.desc: Founded with the ambition of training Madagascar's technological and managerial elite, E-TEC University stands as a major innovation hub.
about.missionDesc: Boost the employability of Malagasy youth through professional training.
about.visionDesc: Become Madagascar's reference institution for training tomorrow's executives and engineers.
about.sloganTitle: A future is built with projects
about.sloganLine2: Everything is possible for those who believe
about.valuesDesc: Every day, our academic community relies on four unwavering pillars.
about.excellenceDesc: Demanding the best of ourselves to guarantee recognised and valued degrees.
about.integrityDesc: Cultivating an ethical, transparent environment that respects individual merits.
about.commitmentDesc: Individually supporting each student towards the success of their life project.
about.innovationDesc: Continuously adapting our infrastructure and technologies to tomorrow's requirements.

news.desc: Stay informed of the latest projects, educational innovations and events of the E-TEC community.

filiers.desc: E-TEC offers excellence curricula designed to meet the innovation and leadership needs of companies in Madagascar and internationally.

admission.desc: Take charge of your professional future. Fill in your admission application in a few clicks for our Faravohitra campuses.
admission.step1Desc: Fill in the pre-registration form with your personal details.
admission.step2Desc: Our teaching team reviews your transcripts and background.
admission.step3Desc: A discussion to understand your ambitions and confirm your direction.
admission.step4Desc: Confirmation of your place after submitting physical documents and tuition.
admission.documentsDesc: Prepare these documents to help us review your application quickly.
admission.document1Desc: Your transcript from the most recent level of study.
admission.document2Desc: A recent document confirming your current address.
admission.document3Desc: Recent official-format photos to include in your file.
admission.document4Desc: A legible copy of your identity card or birth certificate.
admission.documentsNote: Bring the originals for final registration. Additional documents may be requested depending on the program.
admission.formDesc: All fields are required for the review of your initial application.
admission.successDesc: Thank you {prenom}, your pre-registration has been recorded. Our admissions team will contact you by email within 48 hours.

formationInitiale.desc: Initial training is designed for high school graduates and students who want a complete, guided and progressive academic path.
formationInitiale.studyOrgDesc1: Courses are organized by semesters with theoretical modules, practical work, supervised projects and continuous assessments.
formationInitiale.studyOrgDesc2: Each path combines technical skills, professional culture, communication, methodology and job readiness.
formationInitiale.admissionDesc: Submit your file for the next intake.
formationInitiale.readyDesc: Submit your admission request for the next intake.

formationContinue.desc: Continuing training supports employees, entrepreneurs, technicians and job seekers who want to refresh their skills without starting a long program.
formationContinue.feature1Desc: Evening classes, weekends or intensive sessions depending on needs.
formationContinue.feature2Desc: Certification or attendance certificate at the end of the module.
formationContinue.feature3Desc: Career-oriented content that can be applied directly in the workplace.
formationContinue.businessDesc: Modules can be organized in groups, on-site at companies or in open sessions. E-TEC can adapt the content, duration and exercises to the participants' level.

formationsEnLigne.desc: Discover online programs and associated resources to keep learning from anywhere.

historique.desc: Since its creation, E-TEC has built practical, demanding higher education connected to labor market needs.
historique.communityDesc: The story of E-TEC continues with every cohort, every teacher and every partner contributing to its development.

president.desc: A message for students, families and partners who are building E-TEC University's future with us.

organigram.desc: Find the leaders of the administration, departments, faculty and academic teams.

contact.desc: A question about programs, procedures or our campuses? Leave us a message and our team will get back to you as soon as possible.
contact.locationAddr: Lot A 1026 Bis, Faravohitra, near ACEP
contact.formDesc: All fields are required for the quick processing of your message.
contact.successDesc: Thank you {prenom}, your message has been sent. Our team will get back to you very soon.
